title: Ashoka
exam_points: Kalinga yuddh c. 261 BCE (rajyabhishek ke 8ve varsh); Rock Edict XIII mein varnit.
Tisri Bauddh Sangiti Pataliputra mein, adhyaksh Moggaliputta Tissa.
Putra Mahendra aur putri Sanghamitra ko Sri Lanka bheja.
James Prinsep ne 1837 mein Brahmi lipi padhi; Maski abhilekh mein 'Ashoka' naam milta hai.
Sarnath ka Singh-stambh Bharat ka rashtriya chinh.
